scenes.text: Did you know that your body is actually glowing in the dark right now, constantly emitting a very real, ultra-weak light called bioluminescence?

This is the exact same natural chemical reaction that makes deep-sea creatures and fireflies glow, and researchers using super-sensitive cameras discovered that this invisible light peaks in the late afternoon, specifically around your forehead and cheeks.

The reason you cannot see it is because the light your body produces is one thousand times weaker than the maximum sensitivity of your own human eyes, making you a walking lightbulb completely invisible to yourself.
Now that you know you are secretly a shining beacon, what color do you wish your bioluminescence actually was? Tell me in the comments and hit follow for more mind-blowing facts!
